description: matchOutcome() in src/rules/bossBattle.js for every node with a default battle config, plus ids not on the map (0, 999). expected.stars is null for a loss; crowned is a won boss; befriendsCompanionId is the boss's companion (NODE_TO_COMPANION) when won and not in ownedCompanionIds, else null. bossNodeIds lists the boss nodes among them.
